title: Mon 05 Oct 2026: Weak US payrolls cool Fed hike bets, euro area inflation 3.8%, BoE November hike signals, reform deadlines
summary: A weak US jobs report sends Treasury yields lower and lifts Wall Street, while euro area inflation jumps to 3.8 per cent and the Bank of England edges towards a November rate rise. Regulation: where the FCA's asset management reform package stands and the deadlines to calendar; funds: Goldman's NEOS deal and a wave of ETF launches, plus three COO action points and the week's diary.
